fields.description: The name on the vehicle's buttons, e.g. Pilot (WSL).
fields.label: Name

fields.description: Server root only — /api/v3 is added automatically.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The admin account login (not the legacy email).
fields.label: Login

fields.description: Encrypted at rest. site_config overrides it (pilot_admin_password for row 1, pilot_admin2_password for row 2, pilot_admin3_password ...).
fields.label: Password

fields.description: Customer Vehicle field names that hold this connection's Pilot account email, separated by commas, e.g. email_pilot, pilot_tow_email. The first one that is filled is used.
fields.label: Email Fields

fields.description: Ticked: this estate registers vehicles with WASL, so the vehicle gets Check / Link / Remove WASL buttons for it.
fields.label: Uses WASL

fields.description: The cluster node vehicles are created on. Blank = auto (5 when the connection uses WASL).
fields.label: Node
Customer Accounts (live tracking)
fields.description: How a ticket or vehicle reads its live position from Pilot with the CUSTOMER's own account.
Used only when the ticket or vehicle has no Pilot email.
fields.label: Fallback Username

fields.description: The customer account passwords, separated by commas, tried in this order for each account; the one that works is remembered per account. Encrypted at rest.
fields.label: Customer Passwords
